about: Fort Meade, Odenton, Laurel and Columbia, MD: what the route can't hold, checked 11 Nov 2026 (about midnight CST). Transit, on-post perks that need installation access, ceremonies outside the circles, other days, standing perks and closures.

other.name: MDOT MTA: free rides on MARC, Local Bus, Metro Subway, Light Rail, Commuter Bus and Mobility
other.where: All MTA service, including MARC's Odenton, BWI, Savage/Jessup and Laurel stations
other.offer: Free rides for all US military veterans, active-duty military and members of the National Guard and Reserves. Regular schedules.
other.note: Show one of three IDs: a DoD-issued ID (Armed Forces, Uniformed Services or Military Retiree), a VA-issued ID, or an MVA driver's license or state ID with the Veteran designation. A DD-214 is not on MTA's list. Metro (WMATA) and county buses are separate.

other.day: Sale Fri 6 to Thu 12 Nov; challenge coins Wed 11 Nov
other.name: Fort Meade Main Exchange: Veterans Day sale and challenge coins (installation access needed)
other.where: 2799 Rose St, Fort Meade (on post: you need installation access and Exchange shopping privileges)
other.offer: The Exchange's Veterans Day sale on electronics, clothing, shoes and more, 6-12 Nov, with extra savings on select items for MILITARY STAR cardholders. Challenge coins on 11 Nov, while supplies last, for shoppers with in-store benefits (active duty, military retirees and service-connected disabled veterans).
other.note: Not routed: it's on post. A 2020 garrison post about STAR-card fuel and coffee perks is not repeated for 2026. The food court's Charleys, Qdoba and Starbucks are left off the route for the same reason.

sources.publisher: Military.com, reposted by the Exchange Post

other.name: Fort Meade Commissary: holiday hours
other.where: Bldg. 2786 MacArthur Rd, Fort Meade (on post)
other.offer: Open 9 AM-5 PM on Veterans Day (usually 8 AM-9 PM on weekdays). Authorized patrons include veterans with any service-connected disability, Purple Heart recipients, former POWs and designated primary family caregivers.

sources.publisher: Defense Commissary Agency (Fort Meade store page)

other.name: Fort Meade MWR: Veterans Day hours
other.offer: Bowling Center noon-4 PM; Gaffney Fitness Center 8 AM-noon; Murphy Field House 24/7 for registered users. Closed: Club Meade, Arts & Crafts, Auto Skills, the library, Java Cafe, Leisure Travel, Outdoor Recreation's office, the Pet Care Center, Army Community Service and every CYS program.
other.note: From DFMWR's holiday-hours sheet, dated 17 Aug 2026. No 2026 installation Veterans Day ceremony was found (garrison site and news, 11 Nov).

other.name: Crownsville Veterans Cemetery ceremony
other.where: 1122 Sunrise Beach Rd, Crownsville (about 20 minutes east of Odenton)
other.offer: The state's Veterans Day ceremony at the cemetery. Veterans, military families and community members are invited.

other.name: Maryland World War II Memorial ceremony
other.where: 1920 Governor Ritchie Hwy, Annapolis (about 25 minutes east)
other.offer: A Veterans Day ceremony hosted by the Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families.
other.note: Patch doesn't say whether it's open to the public.

other.name: Annapolis Veterans Day ceremony (Fleet Reserve Association)
other.where: Memorial Circle, downtown Annapolis; in bad weather, the Fleet Reserve Club, 100 Compromise St
other.offer: The Fleet Reserve Association's Veterans Day ceremony.

other.name: National Veterans Day Observance at Arlington National Cemetery
other.where: Memorial Amphitheater, Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, VA (MARC to Union Station, free for veterans on 11 Nov, then Metro)
other.offer: The national observance: a wreath-laying at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at 11:00, then the observance in the Memorial Amphitheater. Free and open to the public.
other.note: Expect security screening at the Welcome Center; allow extra time. Metro isn't part of MTA's free rides and runs a weekend schedule (5 AM-midnight) on 11 Nov.

other.name: Laurel Veterans Day Appreciation Breakfast
other.where: Laurel Multiservice Center, 204 Fort Meade Rd, Laurel
other.offer: The City of Laurel's third annual breakfast honoring veterans and military families, hosted by Mayor Keith R. Sydnor.
other.note: Patch doesn't mention an RSVP; the city's November newsletter has details.

other.name: US Army Field Band Saxophone Quartet: Veterans Day concert
other.where: Bain 50+ Center, 5470 Ruth Keeton Way, Columbia
other.offer: A Howard County concert honoring veterans; light refreshments.

other.name: Bubba's 33: free lunch (Glen Burnie, outside the area)
other.offer: A free lunch from select entrees until 4 PM for active, former or retired military with proof of service.
other.note: Bubba's 33 is Texas Roadhouse's sister chain; the nearest store is in Glen Burnie, outside the circles. Call first.

other.name: Maryland State Parks: free day-use entry for veterans
other.where: Every Maryland state park day-use area (Patapsco Valley, Sandy Point and others)
other.offer: Day-use entrance charges are waived for all US veterans, residents or not. Active-duty military and Maryland National Guard members get the same by showing their military ID at the gate.
other.note: For the veteran or card holder only, not others in the car, unless the park charges per vehicle (then the vehicle fee is waived). Other facility charges still apply.

sources.publisher: Maryland DNR (Service Charges for Maryland State Parks)

other.name: National Park Service: fee-free day
other.where: Every National Park Service site that charges entry, such as Fort McHenry in Baltimore
other.offer: Entrance fees are waived at National Park Service sites on Veterans Day.
other.note: Veterans and Gold Star families can also get a free lifetime Interagency Military Pass.

other.day: Usually Tue-Sat 10 AM-4 PM; 11 Nov not confirmed
other.name: National Cryptologic Museum (always free)
other.where: 8290 Colony Seven Rd, Annapolis Junction (beside Fort Meade)
other.offer: NSA's museum of codes and code-breaking; admission is always free.
other.note: Not a Veterans Day offer, and NSA's museum pages reportedly say it closes on federal holidays (nsa.gov couldn't be read here): call (301) 688-5849 before going.

other.name: What's closed and open
other.where: Anne Arundel, Prince George's and Howard counties
other.offer: Federal offices are closed and there's no mail delivery. Anne Arundel County: county offices closed; public schools and libraries open; curbside trash and recycling on the normal schedule. Prince George's County (most of Laurel): county offices, public schools and libraries closed; trash collected. Howard County: the County Council's offices are closed; its full 2026 notice wasn't found (in 2024 its offices, courts, 50+ centers, animal shelter, Robinson Nature Center and historic sites closed while parks stayed open). MARC runs full service on all three lines; Metrorail runs its weekend schedule, 5 AM-midnight.
other.note: Howard County libraries and schools weren't confirmed for 2026: check before going.

leads.name: Joe's Crab Shack (Severn / Arundel Mills)
leads.q: Joe's Crab Shack Arundel Mills Hanover MD
leads.offer: Dealybee's 9 Nov 2026 list: 20% off the meal for veterans dining in, parties up to 4, with a military ID. No store address was found in the area (Joe's locator page is gone; OpenStreetMap has only Halethorpe).
